Today's selection covers 77 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: The Pope isn’t AGI-pilled
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: CISA gives feds 4 days to patch actively exploited cPanel plugin flaw
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, Krebs on Security, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 51 articles published in the last 24 hours
